exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Do you have a favourite flower or plant? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: What kinds of flowers and plants grow near where you live? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Is it important to you to have flowers and plants in your home? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Have you ever bought flowers for someone else? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a review you read about a product or service. You should say: where you read the review what the product or service was what information the review gave about the product or service and explain what you did as a result of reading this review.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: What kinds of things do people write online reviews about in your country?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Why do some people write online reviews?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you think that online reviews are good for both shoppers and companies?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: What do you think it might be like to work in a customer service job?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Do you agree that customers are more likely to complain nowadays?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: How important is it for companies to take all customer complaints seriously?
